title: WATER MAIN BREAK: Nahatan Street closed between Pleasant Street and West Border Road
summary: Norwood Police report a water main break near Nahatan and Winfield Streets. Water service may be affected elsewhere in town. Avoid the area, use alternate routes and allow extra travel time. Do not call 911 for water-related issues unless there is an emergency.

title: All of Route 1 in Norwood — nightly lane closures Sun–Thu, 8 PM–5 AM. Expect delays. Through Nov. 5.
summary: MassDOT milling and paving on Route 1 northbound and southbound from the Walpole town line to the Westwood town line.

title: TONIGHT: Norwood Police community information session on Flock license plate readers
summary: Community information session about the Norwood Police Department’s use of Flock automated license plate reader cameras.
